searchState.description: Check Sogou article search readiness and verification gates after navigating to https://weixin.sogou.com/weixin?type=2&query=<encoded-query>&page=<page>.

returns.description: Extracted record, or ok:false and reason when unavailable.

searchResults.description: Read current Sogou WeChat article result cards. Snippets are not article bodies. Use returned links promptly with navigate_site, then articleState and articleDetail; links may expire. For further pages navigate to the same search URL with page incremented.

returns.description: Extracted record, or ok:false and reason when unavailable.

articleState.description: After opening a Sogou /link or mp.weixin.qq.com/s article in Chrome, wait for redirect completion and a nonempty title and #js_content body. Report challenges and unavailable articles explicitly. A visible publisher-migration notice returns account_migrated with the actual Visit article button destination in migration_url, normalized to HTTPS; this is not article content.

returns.description: Extracted record, or ok:false and reason when unavailable.

articleDetail.description: Read the current WeChat article title, publisher/avatar URL, publication time, source URL, full text, ordered text/image blocks and image URLs from the rendered page. Call after articleState is ready. Article HTML must be read in Chrome; images and video are not transcribed.

returns.description: Extracted record, or ok:false and reason when unavailable.
